origin_vesper.title: The Long Errand
origin_vesper.summary: Someone in the Reach still pays for maps that are not drawn. The letter stays sealed until the mast is longer and a dossier exists for every world here.

origin_anvil.title: A Hold Worth Landing
origin_anvil.summary: The Barn was promised a garden. Hollow Latch will take a core. The charter is not written, and the keel is not yet fat enough to haul a dome.

origin_kestrel.title: Beak and Charter
origin_kestrel.summary: The Compact still has your old squadron on a list. Walking Hollow Latch and surviving the Slat will open that argument. It is not open yet.

authored_shakedown_01.title: Shakedown
authored_shakedown_01.summary: Undock in Helion Dock. Scan Aegis Prime. Cut the ice ring or the seized hold. Bolt one module. Meet the Red Keel and live. Plant a core on Quiet Hollow. Cut glasswheat and keep the hold-kine alive.

authored_aegis_01.title: Aegis Prime Inspection
authored_aegis_01.summary: Seal Aegis Prime and stand the beacon. The inspection writes a dock fee and a rumor.

authored_tallyrock_01.title: Tallyrock Fine Print
authored_tallyrock_01.summary: Read Tallyrock up close. The charter fine print moves the grain price.

authored_blight_01.title: Green Wound Blight
authored_blight_01.summary: A failed crop or a stolen hold-kine on Green Wound changes the price and the rumor.

authored_swallow_01.title: The Swallow Recovery
authored_swallow_01.summary: Bring keel salvage out of the Swallow. A lost craft in that cyclone is a rumor with a price.
